title: Mafia Hero: Streets of Survival
description:
Take Back the City. Tear Down Don Michele's Empire. Save Sofia.

Mafia Hero: Streets of Survival is an online co-op auto-shooter roguelite for up to 4 players, set in the ruthless, mob-controlled streets of 1920s Chicago. Your weapons fire automatically while you dodge relentless enemy hordes, discover powerful upgrades, build your criminal empire, and fight back against corrupt cops, federal agents, rival gangs, and anyone foolish enough to stand in your way.

Fight solo or assemble your crew and take over the city together. Every run is different. Every upgrade shapes your build. Every victory brings you one step closer to your final showdown with Don Michele.

ONE MAN. ONE WAR.

Genny was an ordinary bank clerk. He had an honest job, a quiet life, and Sofia, the woman he loved.

Then Don Michele took her away.

Desperate, Genny ran to the police for help. They laughed in his face. That's when he discovered the truth: the Mafia owned the city, and the law protected those in power.

That night, he stole a pistol, pulled his hat low over his eyes, and walked out the door.

The man who had always followed the rules was gone.

Now he has only one goal: save Sofia and bring Don Michele's empire crashing down.

TAKE OVER THE STREETS

• Online co-op for up to 4 players. Form a crew with your friends or take on the city alone. Enemy difficulty scales with the number of players, making every run fast, chaotic, and unpredictable.

• Every run is unique. Combine weapons, upgrades, and dynamic events to create devastating builds and discover new strategies every time you play.

• The city fights back. The stronger you become, the deadlier and more organized your enemies will be.

BUILD THE PERFECT LOADOUT

• An iconic arsenal. Pistols, revolvers, Tommy Guns, shotguns, bazookas, and many more weapons inspired by the golden age of organized crime.

• Game-changing upgrades. Explosive rounds, Molotov cocktails, grenades, mines, passive abilities, shields, and powerful synergies that completely transform your playstyle.

• Fight alongside your crew. Recruit allies, deploy automated turrets, drones, hired guns, and even a loyal combat dog to fight by your side.

BUILD YOUR CRIMINAL EMPIRE

• Expand your operations while you fight. Illegal distilleries, hidden speakeasies, casinos, and other businesses keep generating cash throughout every run.

• Dynamic events keep every run fresh. Rob banks, hunt down snitches, clash with rival gangs, and seize every opportunity to expand your empire.

• Power attracts attention. The bigger your empire grows, the harder the city will fight to bring you down.

FACE MASSIVE BOSSES

Every boss introduces unique mechanics and demands a different strategy. Battle armored trucks, police blimps, military war machines, and other towering threats that push your build to its limits. At the end of your journey stands Don Michele, the man who took everything from you.

BECOME A LEGEND

• Unlock new playable characters, each with unique abilities and playstyles.

• Permanent progression. Earn Money, Respect, and other rewards to unlock upgrades and grow stronger with every run.

• Experience a true noir atmosphere. Rain-soaked streets, glowing streetlights, thick fog, relentless gunfights, and all the style of 1920s Chicago.

FULL VOICE ACTING

Fully voiced in multiple languages, with full controller support, subtitles, and online co-op.

Start with nothing. Build your empire. Save Sofia. Bring down Don Michele. Become the new King of Chicago.
description_short: Survivors-like game with ONLINE CO-OP (1–4 PLAYERS). The man who had always played by the rules was dead.! Mafia Hero: Streets of Survival is an online co-op auto-shooter roguelite for up to 4 players. Build your criminal empire, craft powerful builds, and battle massive bosses.
